_comment: Per-group animation briefs the maintainer approved by ID on 2026-08-28 from the Scenery Motion Candidates artifact. Each prompt names ONLY the moving part and ends with 'Nothing else moves.' — naming what should stay still backfires, because the model treats those nouns as things to paint (the window-prompt lesson). `example` is the state shown in the artifact and is the pilot subject for that id. DECLINED and deliberately absent: A3 sleeping_giants, C8 signposts, G4 ferns, G5 cliff_vines, L5 toadstool_rings, L9 frost_flowers, W2 cliff_falls.

W1.name: motion
W1.prompt: Animate the wheel only, turning slowly. Nothing else moves.
W1.moves: The wheel turns slowly in the current.

W3.name: motion
W3.prompt: Animate the running water only. Nothing else moves.
W3.moves: Water spouts and the basin surface ripples.

W4.name: motion
W4.prompt: Animate the water surface only. Nothing else moves.
W4.moves: The spring wells up and the surface moves.

W5.name: motion
W5.prompt: This is the same picture in every frame. ONLY the thin wisp of steam moves, drifting slowly upward and thinning as it rises. It must never appear or vanish abruptly. Do not redraw anything else, and do not add or remove anything.
W5.moves: Steam drifts up instead of popping in and out.
W5.superseded_prompt: Animate the rising steam only. Nothing else moves.
W5.revised: 2026-08-29: he rejected the first result. Rewritten to state that every frame is the same picture and to forbid adding or removing anything — the failures were invention and redrawing, not excessive motion.

_declined_note: `declined` records briefs he has rejected outright. animate_motion reads `animations` only, so anything here is inert — it is kept so a later pass can see these were decided, not overlooked.
